Name: Cute Wizard Portraits
Author: nintendojo93
Description:
Really love the Wizard archetype in Harvest Moon, so was sad to see that the wizard in Stardew was well.. a regular ol' wizard!
Then I discovered the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romancable Rasmodius[/url] mod, was overjoyed, and set out to find a new portrait mod. I couldn't find one to my tastes with nine portraits available.
So I decided to try my own hand at it and am currently using it ingame! I hope it can bring you joy too.
I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2181]Leyalluna's portraits[/url]﻿ so I did my best to match their wonderful style so it doesn't stick out too much.
I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3226]Rizum's[/url]﻿ lovely sprites to use as well.
Please let me know any comments! (that aren't that you don't like the style, haha)

Downloads.Description: Unzip in your mods folder! Make sure to tweak the Romancable Rasmodius settings to allow for custom portraits.
